'''Jan Klawiter''' (born 10 November 1950) is a Polish politician. Since 2015 he has been a member of the [[Sejm]] from the parliamentary constituency of [[Gdynia (parliamentary constituency)|Gdynia]]. He was also mayor of his hometown of [[Rumia]] for ten years.<ref>{{cite web|title=Jan Klawiter - Sejm|url=https://www.sejm.gov.pl/sejm8.nsf/posel.xsp?id=157&type=A|language=Polish|accessdate=15 October 2019}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Klawiter is of [[Kashubians|Kashubian]] descent. In 1973, he graduated from [[Gdańsk University of Technology]] and received his PhD when he defended his doctoral dissertation in 1982, on the implementation of liquid chromatographs.<ref name=bio>{{cite web|title=Jan Klawiter|url=http://www.janklawiter.pl/o-mnie/|archive-url=https://archive.today/20140615140806/http://www.janklawiter.pl/o-mnie/|url-status=dead|archive-date=15 June 2014|language=Polish|accessdate=15 October 2019}}</ref> In 1977, he married Urszula Wruk. In 1979 the couple had twins, although both died during birth. In 1983, their daughter Małgorzata was born.<ref name=bio/>

Klawiter is a devout [[Roman Catholic]] and a member of the [[Order of the Holy Sepulchre (Catholic)|Knights of the Holy Sepulcher in Jerusalem]].<ref name=bio/><ref name=natemat/> In his youth he was the president of the local chapter of [[Catholic Action]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Jan Klawiter - radny|url=http://www.pomorskie.eu/pl/bip/umwp/sejmik/radni/j_klawiter|language=Polish|accessdate=15 October 2019}}</ref>

==Political career==
Klawiter served as mayor of his hometown of Rumia from 1992 to 2002.<ref name=bio/>  In 2006, he became a councilor of the Pomeranian Seym from the PiS list, and in 2010 a councilor of the Wejherowo poviat.<ref name=natemat/> On 15 December 2012, he was elected the chairman of the board of the Right of the Republic of Poland in the [[Pomeranian Voivodeship]].<ref>{{cite web|title=I Pomorski Zjazd Wojewódzki Prawicy Rzeczypospolitej|url=http://www.prawicarp.pomorze.pl/index.php/home/97-i-pomorski-zjazd-wojewodzki-prawicy-rzeczypospolitej.html|language=Polish|date=15 June 2014|accessdate=15 October 2019|publisher=Prawicarp Rzeczypospolitej}}</ref> In 2014 he ran as a candidate from the PiS list for the European Parliament, and later for the regional council. In 2015 he was elected to the Sejm.<ref name=natemat/>

Klawiter is heavily against [[Invitro fertilisation|''In vitro'' fertilisation]] and abortion due to his Catholic faith. While he esposes many views held by the far-right in Poland, other politicians have said that Klawiter is always polite in expressing his views. Nonetheless, Dorota Wójcik, president of the Polish chapter of the [[Freedom From Religion Foundation]] expressed discomfort of Klawiter's close connection to the Knights of the Holy Sepulcher in Jerusalem and their leader [[Edwin Frederick O'Brien]].<ref name=natemat>{{cite web|title="Rycerz pana Boga". Ten poseł chce zakazu in vitro – i to nie pierwsza jego bitwa|trans-title="Knight of God". This MP wants an in vitro ban - and this is not his first battle|url=https://natemat.pl/254335,kim-jest-jan-klawiter-ten-posel-wrocil-wlasnie-z-pomyslem-zakazu-in-vitro|website=natemat.pl|first=Jarosław|last=Karpiński|date=8 November 2018|accessdate=15 October 2019|publisher=Prawicarp Rzeczypospolitej}}</ref>
